root: ^Cael: Ah… what a strange hour to meet, acquaintance. Step forward. The world you see is only half the truth.

c-0: ^Cael: You’ve pierced the veil. Your eyes have glimpsed beyond steel… and glimpsed what you may not yet comprehend.
^Cael: Children call it power. Fools call it fire. Magic is the thin skin stretched between what is and what is not… and every spell rends that skin ever so slightly.
c-1: ^Cael: Was… something of the sort. I served in my time, but now I am bound to no ruler.
^Cael: I was once a scholar in a faraway place: the Veilglades. Its college drew students from all corners of the world.
^ I remember every lesson, every tome, every folly… from the betrayal of Maerimond to the dark arts’ transgressions.
^Cael: When I left, the island thrived. Today… it has lost its right to exist in this world.
^ The gods have yet to banish it; its waters remain cursed. Yet the Veilglades endure in memory, at least in mine.
^Cael: Fear not magic. Indulge your intelligence, for that is the way of a true mage.
^ Power will follow. But heed this: every spell demands a hidden price. One day… you will understand, though I hope it is not soon.

s0: ^Cael: Waste not your mana carelessly. It is a vital energy, and replenishing it may cost more than you imagine—by tonics… or the dusk cap mushroom, rare though it grows in Slepbone.
s1: ^Cael: Position is everything. Too close, and even the smallest foe may shatter your incantation.
s2: ^Cael: Some spells may be charged, their power building in patience. Hold them until the moment is right.
s3: ^Cael: Lock upon your enemies. The veil favors the focused mage.
s4: ^Cael: Weaken your foe to magic first, then strike. Even the strongest armor yields to clever application of sorcery.

s0: ^Cael: The Veilglade University sank beneath the ocean long ago. Its library, filled with secret sorceries… lost to the depths. Such knowledge, swallowed by the sea—tragic, really.
s1: ^Cael: They say a huntress still wanders the Veilglades, striving to lift its curse. Perhaps she has glimpsed a future even I cannot see.
s2: ^Cael: The orcs and the elves… some whisper they share a common ancestry. I shall speak no more on that… some truths are best left veiled.
